name_reason: Compliant data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> with the battle-core data_fd2_battle_ prefix (domain=battle, subdomain=pathfind, descriptor=map_width). Accurately reflects both the datum's role (battle map width in tiles per row, the unsigned row stride in tile-index math) and that it is a scalar field of the pathfind state block. No Ghidra address residue; 'width' is a semantic descriptor, not an ID/dimension that needs stripping.
purpose: Runtime battle-map width in tiles per row, one of the pathfind state globals (.object3, 0x60060+). Used as the unsigned row stride when converting (x, y) tile coordinates to a linear tile index (map_width * y + x) in the movement-range flood fill and the destination pathfinder.
logic_summary: Single unsigned byte (BSS, zero at load). Written by both pathfind orchestrators at entry from the tile-map header byte [battle_tile_map_ptr + 0]: fd2_init_movement_range_floodfill @0x4E06F and fd2_pathfind_to_destination @0x4E1F5 (each MOV BL,[EAX]; MOV [0x60068],BL). map_height is stored in the adjacent byte at 0x60069 from [ptr+2]. Readers load it 8-bit and zero-extend (MOV AL,[0x60068]; XOR AH,AH): the two orchestrators use it both as the multiplier in the origin tile-index (map_width * seed_y) and as the right-direction bound ((x+1) < map_width); the recursive helpers fd2_flood_fill_movement_range_recursive @0x4E0EA and fd2_pathfind_recursive_with_direction @0x4E293 reload it to recompute the map_width*4 row stride (the value the binary keeps live in EBP for the whole fill) and to bound-check the right neighbour. 8 xrefs total: 2 WRITE (the orchestrators), 6 READ.
element_semantics: Scalar: battle map width in tiles per row (number of columns). Not an array -- the adjacent byte 0x60069 is the separate map_height field. Used unsigned: as the row-stride multiplier in linear tile-index math (map_width * src_y + src_x), as *4 to form the byte row stride (4 bytes per tile), and as the inclusive-exclusive bound for the right-direction neighbour ((uint8)(x+1) < map_width).
notes: is_const=false: Ghidra shows 2 game-side WRITE xrefs (0x4E06F, 0x4E1F5), so it is genuinely runtime-mutated BSS, not read-only; src correctly declares plain non-const uint8 (line 779). datatype uint8 confirmed by Ghidra listing 'db 0h' and by all reads being 8-bit MOV AL + XOR AH (zero-extend). Memory content all-zero (BSS image), consistent with write-before-read. src comment block (lines 770-779) is already precise and correct (header source [pTile_map+0], adjacent map_height at 0x60069, 8-bit zero-extended load, used as unsigned row stride) -- left unchanged (comment_verdict=keep).
